messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Wellbutrin XL is used to treat MDD and seasonal affective disorder (SAD).
Aplenzin is used to treat MDD and SAD.
Zyban (discontinued) was used to help stop smoking.
Auvelity (bupropion with dextromethorphan) is used to treat MDD in adults.
Contrave (bupropion and naltrexone) is used for weight management for specific patients.
The information on this page is only about bupropion.
It is not about bupropion with dextromethorphan (Auvelity).
It is not about bupropion with naltrexone (Contrave).
Triplet: ["bupropion", "has information page", "this page"]

The relation 'has information page' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity has an information page specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
B. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'contribute to': The subject entity plays a role in the development or occurrence of the object entity.
E. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
